item.title: MacBulwark 1.5.0
item.description:
MacBulwark 1.5 brings a new design, allow-lists, and a firewall that really blocks.

The firewall works

  • In earlier versions macOS never switched on MacBulwark's network filter, so your rules weren't enforced. 1.5 fixes this.
  • After installing, turn the firewall on and approve MacBulwark once in System Settings ▸ General ▸ Login Items & Extensions ▸ Network Extensions. The setup guide walks you through it.

Allow-lists

  • Every app has an "Everything else" setting: block everything except the domains you allow, or allow everything except the domains you block.
  • The more specific domain wins, so you can allow spotify.com and still block log.spotify.com.
  • Helper processes, such as Chrome's, follow their app's rule.

A new look

  • New design and icon, in light and dark. Choose Light, Dark or Match system in Settings ▸ Appearance.
  • Activity: open an app to see every domain it contacted, and block or allow each one, with Undo.

Also new

  • MacBulwark now updates itself: it checks for new versions about once a day. To check right away, choose MacBulwark ▸ Check for Updates…
  • Try MacBulwark free for 7 days.
  • Dropping an audio plug-in on the window explains how to block it through your music app.
